newsitem.title: USA: Frontier, Western Pac. mum on merger.
newsitem.headline: Frontier, Western Pac. mum on merger.

text.p: Two Colorado-based low-cost airlines offered no comment Wednesday on local speculation they may merge in a bid to create a stronger company to better compete with UAL Corp's United Airlines.
Frontier Airline Inc spokesman Bob Schulman said he could not comment on the speculation.
Western Pacific Airlines Inc, based in Colorado Springs, was not available to comment.
Frontier is scheduled to hold a news confernece on Thursday morning to discuss "practices used by Denver's dominant airline to thwart competition," it said in an advisory.
United Airlines is the dominant carrier in Denver, with a 70.5 percent share of the market. Frontier has a 3.9 percent share.
